review_description: We have had our panels in the roof for almost 5 years now, and cannot fault the system. The quote was completed while living in Canberra, and installation booked for Jan 2020 when we moved back home. Everything was done with ease, and we were given a lot of choice and information on what we could install as an East/west configuration.GCR were great to work with and very professional both at purchase and at the install. Grid connection was organised. Basically we did nothing once we had signed off on the install.Highly recommend GCR if looking for good quality panels and workmanship in Hervey Bay.

Gary asked me what I wanted then gave me the advice I needed with no hard sell.Accessibility to the company through Bronwyn and Christabelle was excellent. Calls were answered or returned without delayAny urgency was addressed and timelines modified to suit.Straight down the line no bullshitGood blokesRecommended by a friend and can see why.I have already done same.

Fantastic experience from start to finish. They communicated wonderfully and provided a great system at a fair price. The installation was excellent and the photos and emails, and documentation provided exceeded my expectations. Definitely would recommend and I would use them again.
GCR is a local company and the staff offered the best price to install a medium range package. I could have got a cheaper option from another company, but I decided it would be too risky.

GCR were very professional from the very start. The quote was issued very quickly, the delivery lead time was up front. We were kept informed of the status of the timing of the install and the installation was very quick and efficientThe personnel at GCR were always friendly and helpful.Very professional organization. Highly recommended

Their dealings with me was excellent throughout the whole process.The team of three who installed the system was punctual, efficient and very inclusive in that they kept me informed throughout.This was an add on to my previous micro-inverter system.   They adapted the previous system so that the two systems meshed together and the feed back on how the systems are performing has been excellent giving me information on energy produced, energy consumed and energy exported.When everything was completed and working, they spent time explaining to me how to get the best out of the system and the communication.

Would definitely get GCR back or recommend them to anyone in need of any electrical and solar needs.Thanks again Gary, Christabelle and team.

GCR is a local company who were recommended to me by a friend. I had previously employed them to do other work on my property and knew they were very reliable both for installation and backup service. The owner of the company visited our residence and did a comprehensive explanation of their products which was in line with your own recommendations. Their price was competitive and they were prompt with their installation. I know I can rely on their back-up service if there are any future problems. The were also very prompt in contacting Ergon Energy and arranging everything for our solar connection with Ergon.
